role: Every drop of every block: places each block in a raw region, seeds the world Random and Det's OTHER Math.random stream, calls Block.dropBlockAsItemWithChance and dropXpOnBlockBreak, and records every EntityItem and EntityXPOrb it made in full.
used_by: oracle/Makefile run target (make run CLASS=DropsProbe), dispatched by Oracle.java's {"cmd":"run","class":...}
notes: Its takeOut and MathStream helpers are reused by TickProbe and ExplosionProbe. Output manifest.json, cases.bin, lines.jsonl; the run fails if the region moves after the sweep. No oracle/src file calls into it (grep of oracle/src for the class name); used_by paths under out/java were listed, not opened.
